COWBOY CLEAN

Future rust — guitars, synths, and bad weather.

“Cowboy Clean is what happens when the open range meets the underground club. Matt croons with this deep, dust-worn cowboy baritone, but instead of twangy guitars you get pulsing synths and post-punk textures that shimmer like heat off asphalt. Think Black Marble riding into Twin Peaks with a Stetson and a drum machine.”

— Peter Rittweger, Music Editor, FREEwilliamsburg

Featured EP & Singles

RUBBER KNIFE EP & CATALOG

Rubber Knife is the sound of transformation—songs that cut away old skin, finding hope in loss and embracing the grace of letting go. Joining driving guitars with pulsing analog-style synths and baritone vocals, the EP anchors Cowboy Clean’s live set alongside signature singles “Charcoal” and “Coins.”

Full catalog streaming across all major platforms.

“I wanted the record to be authentic to who I am—caring, soft, but passionate and dedicated... ‘Grendel’ is about the push and pull of the beast within, the dangerous line between ambition and destruction. How do we tame that motivating force without letting it burn down who we want to become?” — Matt Leibowitz

BIOGRAPHY

Cowboy Clean is what happens when the open range meets the underground club. The solo project of NYC multi-instrumentalist Matt Leibowitz, Cowboy Clean joins driving guitars with pulsing synths and post-punk textures. Inspired by a solitude-seeking road trip through the Utah desert, Leibowitz uses his deep, dust-worn baritone to weave a soundscape where Depeche Mode aesthetics collide with the grit of the American West. Cowboy Clean is the takeoff point—the darkest night right before the dawn when the light starts creeping in. What does the desert feel like on a cold New York night? Come to a Cowboy Clean show to find out.
